rulePresets.label: Normal
rulePresets.description: General-purpose community rules for a public or friends-and-community World.
rules: Be respectful to other players and staff.
No griefing, deliberate destruction of other players' builds, or abusive behavior.
No cheating, exploits, or intentionally disruptive automation.
Keep names, chat, builds, and shared content within the server's stated community standards.
Follow moderator instructions and report problems rather than escalating them.
Have fun and help keep the World welcoming.

rulePresets.label: Kids / Family Friendly
rulePresets.description: Stricter family-friendly rules intended for communities that want child-appropriate chat and content.
rules: Keep chat, names, signs, builds, and shared content family friendly.
No profanity, sexual content, graphic content, drug references, or other adult-only material.
No bullying, harassment, threats, hate speech, or targeted insults.
Do not ask minors for private contact details, photographs, addresses, or other sensitive personal information.
No griefing, cheating, scams, or deliberately disruptive play.
Use public/community channels for support and report inappropriate behavior to moderators.

rulePresets.label: Adults Only
rulePresets.description: An 18+ community preset that permits mature conversation while retaining clear conduct boundaries.
rules: This community is intended for adults aged 18 and over.
Mature language and themes may be present, but harassment, hate speech, threats, and targeted abuse are not allowed.
No illegal content, doxxing, scams, malicious links, or attempts to obtain another player's private credentials or personal information.
Respect other players' boundaries and community moderation decisions.
No griefing, cheating, exploits, or deliberately disruptive play unless a clearly labeled event/ruleset explicitly allows it.
Keep all content within applicable platform, game, hosting, and community rules.

rulePresets.label: Roleplay
rulePresets.description: A light roleplay preset for Worlds that want in-character community expectations.
rules: Respect the World setting and other players' roleplay boundaries.
Do not force story outcomes, ownership, combat, or character actions on another player without agreement.
Keep out-of-character disputes out of roleplay channels and resolve them calmly.
No griefing, cheating, harassment, or using roleplay as an excuse to target another player.
Follow event and moderator guidance when participating in organized scenes.

rulePresets.label: Custom
rulePresets.description: A fully editable ruleset owned by the World host.
